Maya (Support): forwarding a customer report — they're seeing structured-json mode stream end abruptly with partial object (parse error on client). customer-provided curl output pasted below. request_id r-0a1b2c3d. can infra/eng take a look?

Jon (Eng): can you paste the raw SSE chunk lines and the request headers they used? also which model + endpoint?

Maya (Support): pasted curl they ran:
```
curl -i -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rc1","mode":"json","prompt":"..."}' \\
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/stream
```
response (customer saw):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\"items\":[1,2"},"index":0}]}

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":",3,4"},"index":0}]}

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"]"},"index":0}]}

# connection abruptly closed by upstream, final closing brace '}' missing -> client json parse error
```

Jon (Eng): thanks. quick note: that pattern (small trailing brace in its own chunk) is normal for our incremental JSON emitter. the problem looks like connection teardown mid-final-chunk. two likely areas: proxy buffering/timeouts or the customer's client closing on idle. can you confirm if there's a proxy (CF/nginx) in front?

Maya (Support): customer says they have an internal HA proxy + Cloudflare in front. asked them to try direct curl to our region endpoint.

InfraBot: Deploy note: nginx-ingress v1.17.3 was rolled at 2165430000 — no config changes applied in that roll.

Jon (Eng): I ran a quick repro locally behind our nginx test proxy. I can reproduce if proxy buffers and then issues an upstream FIN on idle. Repro steps:
```
# emulate client
curl -s -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rc1","mode":"json","prompt":"small"}' \\
  http://localhost:8080/v1/stream > out.sse
# tail shows final chunk split; connection closed before final '}' arrives
```
Mitigation (nginx commonly): set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on;` and `proxy_set_header Connection \"\";` Also ensure upstream keepalive and increase proxy_read_timeout.

Priya (ML): note for engineering: structured JSON streaming emits final small tokens (commas/braces) in their own deltas. clients should accumulate and accept incremental JSON (or wait for explicit stream terminator). short term: ask customer to look for the `data: [DONE]` or use a short read timeout buffer to tolerate out-of-band delays. longer term: we should consider emitting an explicit sentinel event at EOF (e.g., `data: {"__end":true}`) to make parser recovery easier.

Jon (Eng): also suggestion for client-side quick test: `curl --no-buffer` and `--raw` to avoid intermediate buffering. if Cloudflare is used, recommend bypassing it for test or enable `origin-pull` keepalives.

Maya (Support): creating ticket INF-12345, assigned jon. I'll ask customer to test direct curl with --no-buffer and share network trace + any edge proxy logs. will report back. :thumbsup:

Jon (Eng): as a fallback we can implement a best-effort post-parse fix in the SDK that, on final parse failure, attempts to append a closing brace(s) and re-validate (only for diagnostics, behind a flag). not ideal but could reduce breakage while infra changes propagate.

Priya (ML): agreed — flag-only and opt-in. also add telemetry so we can count how many streams fail with final-parse errors.

Maya (Support): customer updated: they tested direct curl and still saw truncation. asked them to run `tcpdump` to confirm whether the FIN came from our side or theirs.

Jon (Eng): I'll pull logs for request_id r-0a1b2c3d and check our frontline LB for abrupt connection resets at 2165432088.

Maya (Support): thanks — keeping customer updated. tagging @Jon (Eng) and @Priya (ML). will add notes to ticket INF-12345 and include their curl output + my repro steps.

InfraBot: Note: no recent config changes flagged on the API fleet in the 2h window.

Jon (Eng): next steps: collect pcap from customer if possible, check LB logs and nginx proxy_read_timeout values, push a small ingress config to disable proxy_buffering on the stream path behind a canary host.

Maya (Support): will set expectation with customer that this is being escalated, ETA for canary is ~2-4h.

(thumbs and :eyes: reactions throughout)
